# ApexCare AI

> The AI-Powered Healthcare Operating System — unifying scheduling, telemedicine, ambient clinical AI, and Zero-Trust security into one platform for patients, providers, and health systems.

ApexCare AI eliminates fragmentation in healthcare by converging patient, provider, and administrator workflows into a single intelligent platform. It includes natural-language scheduling, predictive no-show scoring, WebRTC telemedicine, ambient SOAP note drafting, omnichannel patient agents, and a HIPAA-aligned Zero-Trust security architecture (row-level isolation, immutable audit, leaked-password defense).
